# M12-S2 net: direct syscall.Socket is a CapNet sink (PR3 PRRT_kwDOVOeymc6vVa8U).
# An unallowlisted third-party package that calls syscall.Socket without
# importing net or unsafe must fail under default transitive_net=deny.
# RED: capabilitySinks lacks syscall.Socket, so the build succeeds and the
# `!` expectation fails. No ambient network: the sink is linked, never run.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case A: dep reaches syscall.Socket -> deny.
cd neta/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/netsock$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/ndep'' reaches ''syscall\.Socket'''
stderr 'example\.com/ndep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'transitive_net_allowlist'
cd ../..

# Case B: dep imports syscall but never calls Socket (deadcode) -> passes.
cd netb/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/netsockb$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/netsockb$GOEXE
stdout '^dead-ok$'
cd ../..

# Case C: allowlisted dep reaches syscall.Socket -> passes and runs.
cd netc/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/netsockc$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/netsockc$GOEXE
stdout '^net-ok$'
cd ../..

-- neta/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nmain

go 1.27

require example.com/ndep v0.0.0

replace example.com/ndep => ../ndep

-- neta/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/ndep"

func main() { ndep.Init() }

-- neta/ndep/go.mod --
module example.com/ndep

go 1.27

-- neta/ndep/ndep.go --
package ndep

import "syscall"

func Init() {
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	if fd >= 0 {
		syscall.Close(fd)
	}
}

-- netb/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nmainb

go 1.27

require example.com/ndepb v0.0.0

replace example.com/ndepb => ../ndepb

-- netb/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/ndepb"

func main() { ndepb.Hello() }

-- netb/ndepb/go.mod --
module example.com/ndepb

go 1.27

-- netb/ndepb/ndepb.go --
package ndepb

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
)

var _ = syscall.AF_INET

func Hello() { fmt.Println("dead-ok") }

-- neta/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "deny"

-- netb/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "deny"

-- netc/main/go.mod --
module example.com/nmainc

go 1.27

require example.com/ndepc v0.0.0

replace example.com/ndepc => ../ndepc

-- netc/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "deny"
transitive_net_allowlist = ["example.com/ndepc"]

-- netc/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/ndepc"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(ndepc.Hello()) }

-- netc/ndepc/go.mod --
module example.com/ndepc

go 1.27

-- netc/ndepc/ndepc.go --
package ndepc

import "syscall"

func Hello() string {
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	if fd >= 0 {
		syscall.Close(fd)
	}
	return "net-ok"
}
